messages:
Maya Chen: incident-bot fired for jwt-verify-errors surge in prod auth gateway, paging on-call. seeing a spike in token validation failures (5xx/401 mix). anyone oncall?
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page triggered: INC-2026-0457 - jwt-validate-errors (pager: oncall-auth). escalation: 1 -> 2 after 7m if unacked. links: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026-0457
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Alex Rivera acknowledged INC-2026-0457. Incident owner assigned: Alex Rivera.
Alex Rivera: I'm on it. quick check: are these failures coming from a single region or global?
Maya Chen: looks global but higher in eu-west. dashboards: auth-validate-error-rate spiked from 0.2% -> 12% starting 08:13 UTC.
Alex Rivera: grabbing logs from auth-gateway. attaching sample:
```
time=2026-03-14T08:14:22Z level=warn component=auth-gateway msg="jwt validation failed" err="kid not found in jwks" token_kid="k-2026-03-10"
```
Alex Rivera: kid not found in JWKS is consistent across hundreds of errors. JWKS fetch is returning cached set with older keys.
Samir Patel: pinging key-service oncall (Jordan). Jordan are you around?
Jordan Lee: I'm here. we rolled a key rotation yesterday morning but propagation to the edge JWKS cache didn't complete for some nodes due to a config mismatch in the refresh job. investigating.
Eve Martinez: product reports user login failures for a subset of customers on EU region. some are seeing 401s, some 502s depending on where validation is happening. collecting customer list.
Alex Rivera: immediate mitigation options: 1) switch auth-gateway to fallback to previous public key set (if available) 2) toggle permissive validation to accept tokens signed by either current or fallback keys for 5-10m 3) force JWKS cache refresh across all gateways. prefer sequence 3 then 2 if refresh lags.
Samir Patel: agree. Jordan can you trigger a force-refresh script across the fleet? command below (will run perimeter-safe):
```
for node in $(cat /srv/auth-nodes/prod-nodes); do ssh $node "sudo systemctl restart auth-jwks-refresh" & done
```

Jordan Lee: starting parallel refresh now. I'll iterate on failed nodes. running on 48 nodes.
Alex Rivera: updating incident timeline and customer impact. Prod auth validation error rate down to 7% but still elevated.
Maya Chen: PagerDuty escalation set to delay - don't escalate to oncall-2 yet. want the current rotation team to own.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation timer paused by Maya Chen.
Jordan Lee: update: 5 nodes failed to refresh due to a permission error when trying to access KMS to fetch private key metadata. error: access denied to /var/run/kms/rotation-token. investigating auth around the refresh script credentials.
Alex Rivera: can we fallback to previous cached JWKS (the old keyset) on the nodes that failed?
Jordan Lee: yes, but requires a config flip in the gateway: set ENV ALLOW_FALLBACK_JWKS=true and restart gate binary (no deploy). doing that on failed nodes only.
Alex Rivera: do it. post cmds and check health.
Jordan Lee: running on the 5 failed nodes now. cmd: `sudo systemctl set-environment ALLOW_FALLBACK_JWKS=true && sudo systemctl restart auth-gateway`
Jordan Lee: those nodes came back with jwks now including both keys. validation failures on those nodes dropped to near 0. overall error rate now 1.3%.
Eve Martinez: customer's affected list decreased from ~120 to 12 major tenants. notifying support to open priority tickets.
Alex Rivera: we still see intermittent 401s from edge caches. next step: purge edge JWKS cache CDN entries. Jordan, can you push purge?
Jordan Lee: purge request queued to CDN: POST https://cdn.internal/purge jwks/* -> response 202 accepted. propagation ~2-4m.
Maya Chen: starting on-call handoff note for next shift. include mitigation steps and temporary flags.
Product - Priya: looping in customer success for any high-touch customers, we should prepare a post-incident note.
Alex Rivera: monitoring for 15 more minutes before we close page. metrics stable: auth-validate-error-rate 0.4% and trending down.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Alex Rivera resolved INC-2026-0457. duration: 32m.
Maya Chen: nice work. quick root-cause summary for postmortem: key rotation job had a credential/permission regression causing refresh failures on subset of nodes; JWKS cache stayed stale causing jwt validation (kid not found). fallback and CDN purge mitigated.
Samir Patel: action items: 1) fix refresh job credentials and add unit test for permission checks (owner: Jordan) 2) add automated JWKS propagation check that validates key presence across all edge nodes post-rotation (owner: Eng-Auth) 3) add runbook step to toggle ALLOW_FALLBACK_JWKS and purge CDN for fast mitigation (owner: Alex) 4) customer comms template (owner: Product).
Eve Martinez: I've created internal support tickets and flagged 3 customers for proactive outreach.
Alex Rivera: rolling the credentials fix now to the refresh job repo: branch: fix/jwks-refresh-creds. will run canary then prod deploy.
Jordan Lee: deployed fix to refresh job canary; re-run rotation; all nodes pulled updated JWKS successfully.
Maya Chen: handing off to Samir for post-incident writeup and timeline. Samir please include timestamps and impacted customers.
Samir Patel: taking handoff. I'll draft postmortem and schedule RCA meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC. visible owners assigned.
Product - Priya: we'll prepare customer-facing messaging after RCA.
Maya Chen: closing thread in 1hr if no regressions. thumbs to the team :thumbsup:
Alex Rivera: small note - we should instrument a metric for 'jwks_missing_kid_rate' separately so we get targeted alerts next time. adding to backlog.
Samir Patel: noted. thanks all.
Maya Chen: incident closed (monitoring). final status: mitigated, rollback unnecessary, postmortem scheduled.
